title: Sluneční elektrárny v Česku
description: Sluneční elektrárny v Česku. All 598 solar (PV) power generation/storage units in Czechia carved by native `fueltype` from the powerplantmatching (PyPSA) merged European power plant dataset: name, fuel type, technology, capacity (MW), efficiency, commissioning/retrofit/retirement year, coordinates, storage attributes, ENTSO-E EIC codes and upstream source IDs. Verbatim subset of cs-elektrarny (zero derivation).
